entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Earlier in the day, I learned that..."
entries.dialogueText: Earlier in the day, I learned that Frens Ricter's complaint had been accepted by the Supreme Court for review.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Send him in.""
entries.dialogueText: "Send him in."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I heard that, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I heard that, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Sorry to interrupt, Mr. President,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to interrupt, Mr. President, but Justice Garaci is here to see you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I called Chief Justice Hawker's off..."
entries.dialogueText: I called Chief Justice Hawker's office to demand an explanation, but he wasn't in. I sat by the phone, waiting for him to call back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had also been hearing countless r..."
entries.dialogueText: I had also been hearing countless reports about our police forces becoming reluctant to enforce the rules of the emergency.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I waited and waited."
entries.dialogueText: I waited and waited.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, I heard a knock on the do..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, I heard a knock on the door.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I told you that I'm expecting an i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told you that I'm expecting an important call. No visitors."
entries.menuText: "I told you that I'm expecting an important call. No visitors."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm waiting for Orso Hawker, not H..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm waiting for Orso Hawker, not Heron."
entries.menuText: "I'm waiting for Orso Hawker, not Heron."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""He told me that he's here to talk..."
entries.dialogueText: "He told me that he's here to talk to you about the Emergency Act. He said he couldn't speak on the phone."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Right away.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Send him in.""
entries.dialogueText: "Send him in."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So Orso has sent his pawn.""
entries.dialogueText: "So Orso has sent his pawn."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Um...""

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She opened the door for Heron Garac..."
entries.dialogueText: She opened the door for Heron Garaci and closed the door behind her.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Hello, Mr. President. Sorry to hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hello, Mr. President. Sorry to have come unannounced, but I'm sure you expected us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Heron brushed past Livia and strode..."
entries.dialogueText: Heron brushed past Livia and strode into the office. Livia gave me an apologetic half-smile, turned and closed the door behind her.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""It would be wise of you not to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be wise of you not to be so rude to your partners in the Court."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I'm sorry if I disappointed you, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry if I disappointed you, but the Chief Justice is very busy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Busy? I'm a busy man too, Mr. Gara..."
entries.dialogueText: "Busy? I'm a busy man too, Mr. Garaci."
entries.menuText: "Busy? I'm a busy man too, Mr. Garaci."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're right. I am disappointed.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. I am disappointed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's get to the point.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's get to the point."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What is the Court plotting, Mr. Ga..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is the Court plotting, Mr. Garaci?"
entries.menuText: "What is the Court plotting, Mr. Garaci?"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Of course you are, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course you are, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Life is full of disappointments, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Life is full of disappointments, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We are not plotting anything, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not plotting anything, Mr. President. Please calm down."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You already know that Frens Ricter..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already know that Frens Ricter has filed a complaint about your Emergency Act being unconstitutional. The judges couldn't ignore his arguments."

entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Yes. That's why we need to talk.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. That's why we need to talk."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Our hands are tied. The decrees yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our hands are tied. The decrees you've signed are seen as abuse of power... Although of course, that isn't how Chief Justice Hawker and myself see it."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""But as you know, The Constitution..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as you know, The Constitution states, 'No State shall modify or suspend the rights of freedom defined in Article 100 of the Constitution, unless actually invaded, or in such imminent danger as will not allow for delay.' And this does not seem to be the case..."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""But as you know... the Constitutio..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as you know... the Constitution states, 'No State shall modify or suspend the rights of freedom defined in Article 100 of the Constitution, unless actually invaded, or in such imminent danger as will not allow for delay.' This is fairly clear..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Court has promised not to act..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Court has promised not to act about this clause."
entries.menuText: "The Court has promised not to act about this clause."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't you dare stab me in the back.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you dare stab me in the back."
entries.menuText: "Don't you dare stab me in the back."

entries.dialogueText: "You and Orso are also implicated in this. Don't forget that."
entries.menuText: "You and Orso are also implicated in this. Don't forget that."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Okay, I get it. You have demands."
entries.menuText: "Okay, I get it. You have demands."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Well...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled.

entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are really doing your best, Mr. Garaci."
entries.menuText: "I hope you are really doing your best, Mr. Garaci."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that a threat?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that a threat?"

entries.dialogueText: "No. No. You are getting this all wrong."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci

entries.dialogueText: "Of course we are, Mr. President. Rest assured, everything's going to work out."

entries.dialogueText: "The Court promised not to act on this clause."

entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Well...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well..."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Personally, I believe Sordland is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Personally, I believe Sordland is in more than enough imminent danger to justify the emergency."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""But we must work within the bounda..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we must work within the boundaries defined by our Constitution. I'm sure you understand."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I'll be honest with you. There are..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be honest with you. There are a few justices who are taking Mr. Ricter's side on this. They do believe you are acting unconstitutionally and must be held accountable."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Of course not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We won't.""
entries.dialogueText: "We won't."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""That's true.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's true."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We are simply a little disappointe..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are simply a little disappointed about the lack of proper budget for our police and military forces. This Emergency Act has taken a heavy toll on them."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""And we have a few other suggestion..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we have a few other suggestions that may help you manage this difficult period in the best way possible."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci

entries.dialogueText: "We wish to see you address these concerns before the judicial review is concluded."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what if I don't?""

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci

entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Mr. Hawker and I only want to make..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Hawker and I only want to make sure that you are on our side, Mr. President. Addressing these concerns of ours would be a great place to start."

entries.dialogueText: "There have been countless cases of foreigners joining the fight against our state. We require better border security and a tighter immigration policy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't do that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't do that."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not reply."
entries.dialogueText: I did not reply.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""That's precisely why we are concer..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely why we are concerned about your management of this sensitive period. Keeping the current policy would be a grave mistake."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""That's good to hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's good to hear."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We hope to see you revert your ear..."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We hope to see you revert your ear..."
entries.dialogueText: "We hope to see you revert your earlier decision to relax immigration laws with a decree as soon as possible. We are in an emergency, after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What are you suggesting here?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you suggesting here?"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""They are in close cooperation with..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are in close cooperation with Arcasia and have ties to almost every other country on this continent. And as we all know, they only care about money."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""For example, something has to be d..."
entries.dialogueText: "For example, something has to be done about the Oligarchs. Walter Tusk and Marcel Koronti."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Mr. President, we are worried abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, we are worried about the Oligarchs. Marcel Koronti and Walter Tusk."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""In these difficult times when unit..."
entries.dialogueText: "In these difficult times when unity is so sorely needed, they pose a great threat to all of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Anyway, I am not here to argue wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway, I am not here to argue with you."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I hope our alliance stands strong...."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope our alliance stands strong. As I said earlier, there is nothing to worry about. The Court will reject Mr. Ricter's case..."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Barring any... extraordinary circu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Barring any... extraordinary circumstances."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Of course, there are some justices..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, there are some justices who believe you are to blame. Going against the Constitution is a serious offense, after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Is that a threat?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that a threat?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You promised the Court would side..."
entries.dialogueText: "You promised the Court would side with me."
entries.menuText: "You promised the Court would side with me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What is the meaning of this!?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is the meaning of this!?"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You promised to manage this emerge..."
entries.dialogueText: "You promised to manage this emergency period as best as you can. Yet our police and military forces took a heavy toll with their lack of proper budget."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""This is having very negative effec..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is having very negative effects on Sordland, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We are doing our best to keep the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are doing our best to keep the Court in check, but it seems your decree has made you quite unpopular."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Of course, nobody would go as far..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, nobody would go as far as to impeach you for crimes against the Constitution. Yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Impeach me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Impeach me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What are you suggesting?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you suggesting?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't you dare stab me in the back.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you dare stab me in the back."
entries.menuText: "Don't you dare stab me in the back."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""As you know, the Constitution stat..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, the Constitution states, 'No State shall modify or suspend the rights of freedom defined in Article 100 of the Constitution, unless actually invaded, or in such imminent danger as will not allow for delay.' That does not seem to apply to our current situation..."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I don't know what to say. After al..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what to say. After all, it is up to the majority in the Court if they decide to take action against your decree."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Screw you, Mr. Garaci.""
entries.dialogueText: "Screw you, Mr. Garaci."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You have balls coming to me like t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have balls coming to me like that."
entries.menuText: "You have balls coming to me like that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Listen to me. The Court will rejec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen to me. The Court will reject Ricter's case and I will forget about this conversation. Okay?"
entries.menuText: "Listen to me. The Court will reject Ricter's case and I will forget about this conversation. Okay?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not reply."
entries.dialogueText: I did not reply.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""That depends, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "That depends, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Where are your manners, Mr. Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where are your manners, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Listen...""
entries.dialogueText: "Listen..."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You will implement a nationalizati..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will implement a nationalization plan and seize the assets of the Oligarchs."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Then we will see what happens.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then we will see what happens."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You will regret this. Get out of m..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will regret this. Get out of my sight!"
entries.menuText: "You will regret this. Get out of my sight!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What if I don't?""
entries.dialogueText: "What if I don't?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry. We are on the same si..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. We are on the same side. I will do as you say."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry. We are on the same side. I will do as you say."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We are already working on market e..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are already working on market economy reforms. What you're saying doesn't align with my plans."
entries.menuText: "We are already working on market economy reforms. What you're saying doesn't align with my plans."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Does being impeached align with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Does being impeached align with your plans? Does spending the rest of your term in prison?"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Then it might just be too hard for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then it might just be too hard for us to ignore your crimes against the Constitution."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Whatever you say.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Good. The Old Guard will be waitin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. The Old Guard will be waiting."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I have to say... You are not so di..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say... You are not so different from President Alphonso."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood up and went to the door."
entries.dialogueText: He stood up and went to the door.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Goodbye and good luck, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "Goodbye and good luck, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Well... For now, I must leave. I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... For now, I must leave. I hope you'll think long and hard about what we just talked about."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not shake his hand."
entries.dialogueText: I did not shake his hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I shook his hand."
entries.dialogueText: I shook his hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised an eyebrow and then smile..."
entries.dialogueText: He raised an eyebrow and then smiled.

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Goodbye, Mr. President. Thank you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Goodbye, Mr. President. Thank you for your time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He extended his hand towards mine."
entries.dialogueText: He extended his hand towards mine.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He went out and closed the door beh..."
entries.dialogueText: He went out and closed the door behind him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He went out and closed the door beh..."
entries.dialogueText: He went out and closed the door behind him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I reflected on our conversation for..."
entries.dialogueText: I reflected on our conversation for a moment. Would it be worth re-tightening the laws on immigration to keep the Old Guard happy?

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I decided to comply with Heron's su..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to comply with Heron's suggestion and started to work on a decree to implement tighter immigration laws.
entries.menuText: Start working on a decree to tighten immigration.

entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You played your cards wrong, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "You played your cards wrong, Mr. President. Look at you. You have done virtually *everything* that is possible to oppose us."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""First you ban the Young Sords, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "First you ban the Young Sords, then you make a deal with the communists!"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""We knew you were leaning eastwards..."
entries.dialogueText: "We knew you were leaning eastwards, but accepting financial aid from our enemies? Preposterous!"

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Let me just say this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me just say this."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""They already control much of our e..."
entries.dialogueText: "They already control much of our economy. They can't be allowed to have that much power."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Something must be done. Nationaliz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something must be done. Nationalizing their assets, for example."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That would be too extreme, Mr. Gar..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would be too extreme, Mr. Garaci."
entries.menuText: "That would be too extreme, Mr. Garaci."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will think about it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will think about it."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""Look. I'm not asking you to do any..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look. I'm not asking you to do anything. It's just a friendly suggestion."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That was my plan anyway.""
entries.dialogueText: "That was my plan anyway."
